text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks). 
Following her strong performance in the 
Oka Sho, many had high expectations for 
Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian had claimed the first jewel 
in the recent Satsuki Sho. Seeing that, 
Hishi Amazon burns with drive, unwilling 
to deliver a half-hearted run.
